facts.fact: The Adwave article is dated July 17, 2026.
Adwave states that before connected TV was self-serve, it typically required long decks and six-figure commitments.
facts.quote: Connected TV used to mean long decks and six-figure commitments.

facts.fact: Adwave offers a free site analysis, with the plan shown before any spend.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: Adwave says its creation pricing is metered per image, social video, and TV spot, but the chunk gives no per-unit amounts.
facts.quote: Creation pricing that is metered per image, social video, and TV spot keeps that iteration honest.

facts.fact: Adwave's targeting supports radius, zip, DMA, city, and state modes so advertisers can limit buys to their service area.
facts.quote: Radius, zip, DMA, city, and state modes exist so you are not forced into a national buy.

facts.fact: The article contrasts local performance TV with multimillion-dollar brand flights, a traditional national TV buying model.
